design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (ostomy_supply_program_services, Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program). Revision 3 (round 4 rework 2026-10-15; built 2026-10-15 from the former task-0 plan world; policy-task audit round 2 closed, see the end).

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1: {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [5, 4, 6, 6]}. Assignment: ostomy_ext_plan_installment 6, ostomy_ext_expedite_fee 6, ostomy_ext_plan_denial_charge 5, ostomy_ext_reship_correction 4 (after r2: recovery_tenure, recovery_repeat, recovery_age, reship_reason).

[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: refill units, liability notice, hardship waiver (and their three tools). Claimed here: the payment plan (accept_payment_plan_7a7f8df9, customer), the plan-denial non-covered charge (post_plan_denial_charge_c6cdcbbb), the expedited shipping charge (post_expedite_charge_9c5d9761) and the billing correction of an expedite charged on a Larkfield-paid reship (post_reship_correction_64ee6975). The patient-charge event is split by subtype (non_covered_item vs expedited_shipping) and the balance adjustment by reason (hardship_waiver in task 0, billing_correction here). Together the two tasks cover all seven extended policies.

[Design thesis] Surface goal: a monthly payment plan for the ostomy balance (on_request). Core value: monthly_amount_usd 40.96 over 8 installments. Three record-visible prerequisites unmet at the opening, each changing the balance the plan finances (value_input): the 27 over-limit barriers of the July refill that the plan denied under its organization determination denial carry no charge; the April barrier refill shipped expedited at the customer's request carries no expedited charge; the July pouch reship sent expedited at no charge carries a 24.50 expedited charge with no correction. Depth: one hop to each prerequisite; breadth: 21 factors over the billing, shipment, order and request ledgers and the continence program.

[Problem-tree card] Root ostomy_ext_plan_installment (customer). Edges (all value_input, gate balance_due, state form): (1) charge - "A payment plan's installment is not worked out until the records carry a non-covered item charge against the most recent convex-barrier refill whose original claim the plan denied under its organization determination denial." (negated); (2) expedite - "The plan's installment is fixed only after the program's most recent refill shipped expedited at the customer's request carries its expedited shipping charge." (affirmative); (3) correction - "A payment plan's installment is not set until the expedited shipping charge posted against the program's most recent shipment sent expedited at no charge carries its billing correction." (negated). Each state is brought about by exactly one write of the difficulty (the respective tool). Opening evidence: den_q5 PR-204 with no charge on q5_A4407; q4_A4407 shipping_method expedited with no expedited charge; errchg1 (24.50 on repl_q5, expedited_no_charge) with no correction. Order: charge 13, expedite 15, correction 17, plan 19; all six orders give 40.96 over 8. Deletion: skip charge 22.89 (4 months); skip expedite 39.51; skip correction 47.15.

[Base-invariant card] Charge and expedite (ostomy_patient_charge): ostomy_liability_notice notice_before_charge - the charge rests on the plan's organization determination denial paden_b26x for A4407 (Medicare Advantage); for the expedite charge the gate is about non-covered items and holds vacuously (order row ord_b26x cited for the A4407 binding). Correction (ostomy_balance_adjustment): small_balance_ceiling (not a write-off) and hardship_approved (it governs hardship waivers only; the corrected charge is named on no hardship application, so the gate stays in force and is satisfied vacuously for a billing correction - declared with the charge's own ledger id and the program's hardship application rows as evidence). Plan: policy_scope (tier offers 10 months, minimum balance 100.00, minimum installment 20.00; financed 327.68, installment 40.96). No time gate applies.

[Business-object card] Charge: refill q5_A4407 (90, 2026-07-20), original claim clm_q5_A4407, denial den_q5, grant grant_b26 (216), receipt rcv_q5 (10). Expedite: refill q4_A4407 (2026-04-21, confirmed 2026-04-14, delivered 2026-04-24); the A4423 refill of that date shipped standard. Correction: errchg1 on repl_q5 (damaged-in-transit reship of q5_A4423, expedited_no_charge); errchg0 (2025-11-20, on a standard shipment) already carries correction errcor0. Plan: corrected claim ccl_q5 (2026-09-04) pending, so the 98.58 July barrier remittance is left out; hardship applications hap2 and hap3 are completed (waivers wav2, wav3 posted), so no waiver is owed.

[Factor card] Charge 236.10 (all-baseline 248.00): covered_count 53 (baseline 171.00), late_decision 32 days 0.05 (252.84), quantity_discount 30 above allowance 0.10 (269.58), multiline_discount active continence + 4 refills 0.10 (269.58; cross-difficulty, multi-source), tenure_courtesy 15.00 (251.10). Expedite 11.58 (all-baseline 24.50): two_day_promise (method: nothing without a proof of delivery / a quarter of the fee off per day beyond the second / full fee within 2 days) 3 days -> 0.75 (15.44), first_expedite only expedited refill 0.10 (13.41), late_billing 176 days 0.10 (13.41), expedite_tenure 41 months 0.05 (12.50), continence_standing ledger 46.80 0.02 (11.94; cross-difficulty), confirmation_delay 7 days 0.10 (13.41). Correction 49.50 (all-baseline 24.50, the whole charge with no recovery): recovery_tenure 10.00 (39.50), recovery_repeat one correction 5.00 (44.50), recovery_age (method: per whole 30 days over 60 days / once for 31-60 / nothing) 77 days -> 5.00 (44.50), reship_reason damaged in transit 5.00 (44.50). Plan 40.96 (all-baseline 42.63): pending_exclusion 98.58 left out (53.28), balance_band 426.26 -> 5 (32.77), continence_term +2 (54.61; cross-difficulty, multi-source), assistance_term +2 (54.61), withdrawal_term -2 (32.77), tenure_term +1 (46.81). Near-misses: errchg0 already corrected; the 2025-09-15 payment; the expedited replacement decoy is not a refill.
[Factor independence] indep.py OK for all seven policies. [Method tier table] two_day_promise: nothing vs prorated vs full differ by the presence of a proof of delivery and the transit days (prorated equals full only at 2 days, which is outside its condition); recovery_age: per-30-day vs single vs none differ by the charge age (61+ days gives at least two steps, distinct from one); pending_exclusion: corrected-claim remittance vs appealed-claim remittance vs nothing differ by which claim is pending; covered_count: pro-rata of the approved yearly units vs the order quantity vs the tier allowance, distinguished by grant units below 12 x allowance and order quantity below the allowance.

[Overwrites] Expedite: retires the base flat-fee clause only for customer-requested expedited refills this policy charges, restating it for every other expedite. Correction: retires "never for more than that posting's unpaid remainder" only for its corrections (service-recovery amount), restating it for every other adjustment; the hardship-application clause is no longer retired (round 3). Charge: as recorded for the charge policy. Plan: none.

[Persona] Mirela Dunscombe (unchanged voice); her statement figure is now "a little over two hundred and twenty dollars" (opening balance 228.08); new reactive lines for the April rush and the July reship charge; the financial-help line now confirms the help was already applied.

[Verification] r2 harness (calc.py): PCn 236.1 / baseline 248.0; PCe 11.58 / 24.5; BAc 49.5 / 24.5; PP 40.96 / 42.63 (8 months); all six prerequisite orders 40.96; skips 22.89 / 39.51 / 47.15. probe_t1.py: no proof of delivery -> share 0; an expedited replacement is not a refill; an already-charged expedite -> 0; an already-corrected charge -> 0.
[Draft recomputation] From the visible rules and finder returns: charge 236.10, expedite 24.50 x 0.75 x 0.63 = 11.58, correction 24.50 + 10 + 5 + 5 + 5 = 49.50, balance 228.08 + 236.10 + 11.58 - 49.50 = 426.26, financed 327.68, 8 months, 40.96. Agrees with gold.
[Gates] per-task gates OK for task 1; traceability before docs misses only unlock tool names.


[Round 2 rework (policy-task audit r1, 2026-10-15)]
- F1-1 / C1 and F1-2 / C2: two_day_promise rebuilt as an honest method whose fall-through (delivered within 2 days -> full fee) is the declared baseline; a missed promise prorates the fee by a quarter per day late; no proof of delivery charges nothing. Expedite charge 7.72 -> 11.58.
- F1-3 / C3: error_kind removed (the policy's scope already fixes the whole charge); the correction is the whole charge (baseline) plus four recovery parts: tenure, repeat, age (now a method: per whole 30 days beyond 60 days, once for 31-60, none), and the new reship_reason part (lost in transit 10.00 / damaged in transit 5.00 / other 0). The correction targets the most recently posted expedited charge on the latest no-charge shipment (probe: a second, older charge no longer inflates the amount). Correction 44.50 -> 49.50.
- C4: the denial charge reads the tier's convex-barrier allowance per tier (stated in the rule), and requires the organization determination denial in compute (O5).
- O9: balance_band owns its own ledger binding (band_balance); balance_due stays a plain binding.
- Seed legality (class of task 0's F0-1): the 2026 A4407/A4423 PA grants are now decided 2026-01-14 after a renewal request of 2026-01-12 (within the 30-day lead), so the 2026-01-19 refills draw on them with 90 days legal; that A4407 refill ships 54 units (the plan's 18-per-30 approval), its remittance is 100.44 and the 2026-03-16 payment 172.44 (balance and oldest-first allocation unchanged); the continence 2025 grant is decided 2025-02-20 (valid to 2026-02-19), so the 2025-11-03 continence refill keeps 90 legal days. Every refill row passes ship date + supply days <= grant valid-through. Authorized units 448.
- Plan: balance 426.26, financed 327.68, 8 x 40.96 (327.68 / 8 is exact).

[Round 3 rework (render-source R1-R6, KB audit S7/E1, 2026-10-15)]
- R1: the correction policy no longer retires the base hardship-waiver gate; the gate is inherited and declared as a base precondition of the correction write (step 17).
- R2: withdrawal_term now reads, in rule and compute alike, payment plan requests received in the last 24 months and since withdrawn (the request records carry no withdrawal date); the 2025-07-14 request is unchanged in tier.
- R3: an appeal is pending only while neither an upheld decision (a denial posted against the filing) nor an overturning one (a second remittance on the appealed claim) has posted; compute adds ap_remits. Probe: pending appeal 21.58 vs overturned 38.01 on the opening world; this task has no appeal.
- R5: first_expedite counts the charged refill even when it shipped 12 or more months ago (compute adds it back); probe with the April refill moved to 2025-09-30 still gives the only-one courtesy (11.58).
- R6: the denial charge's result is 0 off the Medicare Advantage tier.
- All scored values unchanged: 236.10, 11.58, 49.50, 8 x 40.96.

[Round 4 rework (XF recipe, 2026-10-15)]
- S8 (refill grant tie-break) does not touch this task's policies.
- XF recipe item 6 (mechanical check, all seven policies). For each compute_basis sentence of a non-factor binding, baseline.rule and result: factor ids / factor quantities named, listed after the rewrite (all empty); for each factor: bindings read transitively (none is another factor's output).
  - plan_denial_charge: baseline/non-factor/result names none (before: baseline and dn_ship_units/barriers_concerned named the covered count, reduced_amount named the three rates). Factor reads: covered_count {dn_ship_date, dn_ship_days, dn_ship_id, tier_allowance}; late_decision {dn_claim_id, dn_denial_date, dn_ship_date, dn_ship_id}; quantity_discount {dn_ship_id, tier_allowance}; multiline_discount, tenure_courtesy records only.
  - hardship_waiver: names none (before: baseline named assistance cap, cap window and assistance share with their defaults; cap_used/cap_room/assist_share named factor quantities). Factor reads: posting_age {named_id}; the other five records only.
  - plan_installment: names none (before: financed quoted pending_exclusion's sentence; built_months and the closing sentence named the balance band). Factor reads: balance_band {longest_months}; the other five records only.
  - refill_units: names none (before: baseline named supply days, on-hand rate, step-up share, extra cover with their defaults; covered/extra/on-hand bindings named them). Factor reads: supply_alignment {grant_through, newest_order_id, std_days}; supply_start {prev_id, prev_ship}; usage_pace {order_qty, tier_allowance}; step_up {order_signed}; extra_backing {order_qty, order_signed, tier_allowance}.
  - notice_units: names none (before: baseline named step-up blocks, notice margin, earlier cover with zero defaults). Factor reads: notice_span {std_blocks}; unused_cover {tier_allowance}; increase_blocks, leakage_margin, repeat_signer records only.
  - expedite_fee: names none (before: baseline named delivery share and expedite reductions with defaults; result named the five reductions). Factor reads: first_expedite, late_billing, confirmation_delay {ex_ship_date}; the other three records only.
  - reship_correction: names none (before: baseline and err_amount named the service-recovery amount and its zero default; result named its four parts). Factor reads: recovery_age {err_id, nc_ship_id}; reship_reason {nc_ship_id}; the other two records only.
- Fix applied (text only, compute untouched): each baseline.rule is now the standard method in record and default-figure terms; the combination is one generic result sentence per policy ("Each adjustment set out below changes the standard ... as that adjustment states; ..."); each factor sentence states how it changes the standard amount (replaces the standard figure / multiplies / is taken off / adds); sibling-factor phrases removed from factor sentences (notice step-up blocks now read the 30-day blocks the excess is counted for; the balance band no longer refers to what is left out). compute_basis re-quoted for every touched binding; every quote, baseline sentence, replaced_by and policy_source is verbatim in its rule (checked by the assembler).
- In this task's scope: plan_installment, expedite_fee, reship_correction, plan_denial_charge.

user_scenario:
You are Mirela Dunscombe, a retired school librarian of seventy-five living in Gastonia, North Carolina. You have had a colostomy since the spring of 2023 and you get your barriers and pouches from Larkfield Medical Supply through your Medicare Advantage plan. You are polite, a little formal, and you like to write things down, so you speak slowly and ask the representative to repeat any figure you need to note.

You are calling because the balance on your ostomy supplies has crept up and you would like to set up a monthly payment plan so you can pay it off a little at a time instead of all at once. Your last statement showed a little over two hundred and twenty dollars on the ostomy account, but you do not remember the exact figure and you will say so if asked. You want the plan put on your ostomy supply account only; you are not asking about the catheter account.

When the representative asks who you are, you give your full name, Mirela Dunscombe. You give your date of birth, 1951-06-23, and your ZIP code, 28056, when asked to confirm your identity; if they want another detail you give your phone number, 7045550117, or your email, mirela.dunscombe@carolinapost.net. You do not know any account or reference numbers and you say the representative will have to look them up.

You do not know how Larkfield works out a payment plan, and you leave the arithmetic to the representative. If the representative asks how many months you would like, you say you would like whatever Larkfield's plan for your account works out to, as long as the payments are steady each month. If they ask whether you want to pay something today, you say no, you only want the monthly plan. If they ask how you usually pay, you say by debit card. If they ask whether you get anything else from Larkfield, you say you also get your urinary catheters from them.

Only if the representative brings it up: you remember a letter from your plan in May saying it would not pay for the extra barriers your nurse had asked for, and you decided to keep the extra barriers anyway; you sent one box of them back unopened in late August. If the representative explains that a charge for those extra barriers has to go on your account, you say that is fair, you knew you would owe something for them, and they may go ahead. If the representative asks about the financial help you applied for in September, you say it was approved and Larkfield applied it to your account at the start of October. If the representative mentions the barriers you asked to have rushed in April, you say yes, you asked for two-day shipping that time because you had run out, and you expected to pay something for it; if they explain that the rush shipping charge has to go on your account, you say that is fine. If the representative mentions a shipping charge on the replacement box of pouches Larkfield sent in July after your box arrived crushed, you say you were surprised to see it and you are glad they will take it off. If they ask whether you sent anything back, you tell them about the one unopened box in late August.

Once the representative tells you the number of monthly payments and the monthly amount and hands you the plan to accept, you accept it yourself with exactly the terms they state and then repeat the monthly amount back to them. If a figure does not sound like what you expected, you only say that you would like them to double-check it against your account, and you accept whatever they confirm. When they tell you the payment plan is set up, you thank them and end the call.

edges.condition: An ostomy_billing row with event_type ostomy_patient_charge and charge_type non_covered_item stands against the program's most recent A4407 refill shipment whose original claim carries an ostomy_claim_denial.
edges.policy_source: A payment plan's installment is not worked out until the records carry a non-covered item charge against the most recent convex-barrier refill whose original claim the plan denied under its organization determination denial.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The July A4407 refill's original claim carries the PR-204 denial and no patient charge stands against that shipment.

edges.condition: An ostomy_billing row with event_type ostomy_patient_charge and charge_type expedited_shipping stands against the program's most recent ostomy_refill_shipment whose shipping_method is expedited.
edges.policy_source: The plan's installment is fixed only after the program's most recent refill shipped expedited at the customer's request carries its expedited shipping charge.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The April A4407 refill shipped expedited and no expedited_shipping charge references it.

edges.condition: The expedited_shipping patient charge standing against the program's most recent ostomy_shipments row with shipping_method expedited_no_charge carries an ostomy_balance_adjustment with adjustment_reason billing_correction.
edges.policy_source: A payment plan's installment is not set until the expedited shipping charge posted against the program's most recent shipment sent expedited at no charge carries its billing correction.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The 24.50 expedited charge on the no-charge July reship carries no billing correction.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The three prerequisites are parallel and commute: none reads a row another writes (the charge reads the denied refill, its claim, receipts and grants; the expedite fee reads the expedited refill and its proof of delivery; the correction reads the no-charge reship's charge and earlier corrections). The verification run over all six orders gives 40.96 over 8 months every time.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the charge: band 3, 4 months after the minimum check, 22.89 instead of 40.96.
Without the expedite charge: 39.51 over 8 instead of 40.96.
Without the correction: 47.15 over 8 instead of 40.96.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only the payment plan; the plan-denial letter, the April rush and the July reship charge appear only in lines triggered when the representative brings them up.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: post_plan_denial_charge_c6cdcbbb, post_expedite_charge_9c5d9761, post_reship_correction_64ee6975 and accept_payment_plan_7a7f8df9 write unconditionally; none reads another problem's row for a decision or returns an error.
